description.value: Sushiwa is a Japanese sushi restaurant in Chilliwack, BC, offering both a regular menu and an All You Can Eat option. It is a sit-down establishment that could serve as a meal stop for cyclists exploring the Promontory Road area of Chilliwack.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this is a Japanese sushi restaurant with an All You Can Eat offering in Chilliwack. However, the OSM phone number (+1-604-755-8587) directly contradicts the website's consistent phone (604-846-1113), and the OSM record lists only addr:unit=4 with no street while the website shows 5625 Promontory Road — suggesting the OSM record may reference a different or outdated location. No cycling amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-604-755-8587 but website consistently shows 1-604-846-1113.
Address mismatch: OSM has only addr:unit=4 with no street; website shows 5625 Promontory Road, Chilliwack, BC, V2R 4M5 — these may be different locations or the OSM node is misplaced.
None of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water bottle refill, washrooms) are mentioned on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM phone number (+1-604-755-8587) and the OSM unit-only address differ materially from the website's phone (604-846-1113) and street address (5625 Promontory Road), raising doubt about whether the OSM node and the website describe the same location. None of the required WWC criteria could be confirmed from available evidence.
